summary: Iter-7 regression for Deal Room enhancements: (a) E-commerce/DTC DRL template, (b) typed-name NDA e-signature, (c) GridFS binary file upload + download, (d) page-level citations in AI findings, (e) /app/rooms and /app/rooms/:id frontend routes. Backend: 86/86 pytest cases PASS in 223s (13 new iter-7 tests added on top of prior 73; all 73 prior tests still green — existing nda_accepted fixture migrated to send signed_name body). Frontend: NDA gate UI, Files tab upload-mode switcher, file picker accept attr, Download button, citation 'p.N' rendering, and new routes — all verified live against alex@workz.example.com on the existing Helios room and the fresh pending-NDA Acme room.

minor.issue: File input accept attribute on frontend allows .pdf,.docx,.txt,.md,.csv,.xlsx,.png,.jpg,.jpeg but backend extract_pages_from_bytes only handles PDF/DOCX/TXT explicitly. An .xlsx or .png upload will fall through to a 1-page placeholder or empty pages with no clear 415/400 — recommend either narrowing the frontend accept attr to the actually supported types or adding an explicit 415 response on unsupported MIME.

Empty multipart file returns 400 correctly, but the >25MB cap was NOT exercised in this run because uploading a 25MB body via test harness against the public preview URL is rate-limit/cost prohibitive. Code path inspected and looks correct; recommend a unit test with a stubbed UploadFile of size 26*1024*1024 to lock in 413.

Audit log entry 'dealroom.file.download' creation was not asserted in tests (would require querying /api/audit/logs with kind filter after download). Spec mentioned this side-effect — recommend adding a kind='dealroom.file.download' filter to /audit/logs and asserting the entry appears after a download call.

issues: File input accept attribute accepts .png/.jpg/.jpeg/.xlsx/.md/.csv but backend extract_pages_from_bytes only handles PDF/DOCX/TXT — UX promise broader than backend support. User uploading a PNG will get a successful upload with page_count=1 and no extractable text, then findings generation will silently ignore it.

action_items: Narrow frontend file input `accept` to '.pdf,.docx,.txt' OR add explicit 415 Unsupported Media Type for non-PDF/DOCX/TXT mime types in /files/binary endpoint.
Add a unit/integration test that uploads a 26MB stub file and asserts 413 response — current public-URL test suite skips this case.
Add audit-log assertion test for 'dealroom.file.download' kind after a successful download (introspect via /api/audit/logs kind filter).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown further with GridFS imports + 2 new endpoints + extract helpers — iter-6 split-into-routers recommendation is increasingly urgent. Also: deal_room_files_fs GridFS bucket has no startup index on metadata.room_id, so downloads + counts will scan every file across all rooms once volume grows.
extract_pages_from_bytes silently returns a single 'placeholder' page for unknown filetypes — should raise a 415 instead so the client knows the file was useless for findings/copilot.

Carried over from iter-6: open-room still doesn't gate on inquiry.status=='engaged'; auto-match still has silent except branch; /drl still wipes prior requests including satisfied; findings still don't post-verify excerpt against file content; CORS '*' with credentials true; no email unique index.
Frontend DealRoomDetail.jsx is 622 lines — could split NDA gate, files-tab, drl-tab, findings-tab, copilot-tab into sub-components for testability.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — renamed test_drl_templates_returns_six → test_drl_templates_returns_all_sectors; added test_drl_template_ecommerce_present; migrated nda_accepted fixture + test_seller_cannot_accept_nda + empty-room test to send signed_name body; added test_accept_nda_empty_name_rejected, test_accept_nda_short_name_rejected, test_accept_nda_updates_room asserts nda_signed_name+nda_signed_by_user_id; added 9 new tests for binary upload (GridFS metadata, empty=400, pending_nda=400, non-participant=403), download (streams content with attachment+filename, 404 on missing, 403 outsider, 400 on text-only file), findings page citation int, and legacy text upload backwards-compat.
